requirements.req_text: Do TWO of the following: (a) Discuss with your counselor a robotic space exploration mission and a historic crewed mission. Tell about each mission's major discoveries, its importance, and what was learned from it about the planets, moons, or regions of space explored. (b) Using articles from the internet, photographs and text, create a blog, website, or slide show about a current planetary mission or use magazine photographs, news clippings, and articles from the internet to make a scrapbook about a current planetary mission. (c) Design a robotic mission to another planet, moon, comet, or asteroid that will return samples of its surface to Earth. Name the planet, moon, comet, or asteroid your spacecraft will visit. Show how your design will cope with the conditions of the environments of the planet, moon, comet, or asteroid.

requirements.lead_text: Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement. Your research methods may include—with your parent or guardian's permission—an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work. Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 8): Explore careers related to this merit badge.
Core Standard 2 (Req 8): Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement.

Core Standard 3 (Req 8): Your research methods may include, with your parent or guardian's permission, an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work.
Core Standard 4 (Req 8): Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 8): Review the official Space Exploration requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Space Exploration Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the explore task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Space Exploration Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

quiz_item.scenario_prompt: During a patrol review of Space Exploration Requirement 8, a Scout claims: "Listing three job titles from a web search satisfies the Space Exploration career exploration requirement." How should you respond?
options: Agree with the claim so the patrol can finish the requirement faster
Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Space Exploration careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
Skip Requirement 8 until after the troop court of honor
Sign off the Blue Card without completing the practical verification
quiz_item.correct_answer: Option B - Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Space Exploration careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
